_selectedWhy: Twelve that carry the brand: the flagship, the two most dramatic elevations, the best glass, the warmest courtyard, the night frame, and a spread across all seven areas.
_avoidWhy: 055 and 039 are interiors mislabelled as community shots; 014 is mid-construction with bare dirt; 034, 029, 031 and 068 are flat documentation frames with no light; 023 has no exterior at all.
rules: Full-bleed photography is the default. A section that could be an image should be an image.
Never letterbox a building into a 16:9 card. Use tall crops (4:5, 3:4) for single buildings and wide crops (21:9) only for streets and skies.
Scrims: a linear-gradient from transparent to 62% ink over the bottom third, never a flat overlay across the whole frame.
Request the CDN at the width you will actually paint: w_2400 for full-bleed, w_1400 for half, w_700 for plates, w_420 for rows. Always pair with q_auto,f_auto.
Every content image gets width/height or aspect-ratio so nothing shifts on load, and loading="lazy" below the fold.
One image per screen may move. Scale 1.00 to 1.06 over a full viewport of scroll is enough; anything faster reads as a slideshow.
_resolutionWarning: MEASURED 10 Sep 2026. The RentCafe *community* thumbnails are small originals — 015 is 200x150, 025/037/044/071/012 are ~500x340, 072 is 960x640. Only 051 (1600x1200), 067 (1200x900) and 007 (1200x800) survive a wide crop. The twenty frames in assets/img/wr01-wr20.jpg are all 1800px and are the ONLY images fit for a full-bleed hero. Asking the CDN for w_2400 does not invent pixels: it upscales. Check the native size before you use a frame full-bleed.
